messages:
sam: hey team — awful timing but my flight just got cancelled (SFO -> JFK). i was primary for 00:00-06:00 UTC tonight. i won't make it back in time. can someone pick up primary? i can stay available by phone for any context. :disappointed_relieved:

oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered earlier: INC-7821 — error-rate spike on inference-ingress (auto-resolved). Please confirm primary/secondary for upcoming shift.

sam: quick context: early surge caused transient OOMs on a model worker; we evicted a bad pod and rolled a canary, traffic is back to baseline but we had recency errors for a few customers. runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/ingress-oom (ops-runbook-bot will post snippets). i did NOT run a full cluster restart.

ops-runbook-bot: runbook excerpt: 
```
If OOM on model-worker:
 1) kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=model-worker
 2) kubectl describe pod <pod> | grep -A4 Events
 3) kubectl delete pod <bad-pod> --grace-period=0 --force
 4) watch -n 2 kubectl logs -n inference svc/ingress --tail=200
 5) if errors persist: scale replicas to +1: kubectl -n inference scale deploy/model-worker --replicas=$(($(kubectl -n inference get deploy model-worker -o jsonpath='{.status.replicas}')+1))
```

maya: i can cover 01:00-05:00 UTC (i have a deploy tonight at 23:30 PT but can hand off after 01:00). i'm comfortable doing the first-hour stabilization if someone else can take the later block. i can also ack the pager if needed.

lucas: i can take 00:00-06:00 UTC full handoff if needed. i'm on APAC hours so i'll be up. happy to be primary. is there any customer-facing incident open? need customers list to triage.

jordan: i can be secondary/backup for 00:00-06:00 UTC. will monitor alerts and take over if primary is paged. please add me to PagerDuty escalation for this thread.

sam: thanks all. customers affected earlier were: customer-a (high QPS), customer-b (low QPS but sensitive). impact: increased latency and occasional 5xx for <15 minutes. mitigation so far: evicted bad pod, increased model-worker replicas by +1 on canary, traffic routing back to stable model.

maya: ok if lucas wants full block, i'll shadow first hour then sign off to him at 02:00 UTC (give buffer for deploy fallout).

lucas: sounds good — i'll be primary 00:00-06:00 UTC. jordan as secondary, maya shadow until 02:00 UTC. i'll update PagerDuty and Slack status.

lucas: updating runbook steps i'm likely to run if the OOM recurs:
```
# quick mitigation
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=model-worker -o wide
kubectl -n inference exec -it <pod> -- /bin/sh -c 'top -b -n1 | head -n20'
kubectl -n inference delete pod <problem-pod> --grace-period=0 --force
# scale to absorb traffic
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/model-worker --replicas=6
# verify logs
journalctl -u inference-service -n 200 --no-pager | grep ERROR
```

jordan: settled. i'll confirm i'm on PD escalation and add my mobile. @oncall-bot please set escalation: primary=lucas secondary=jordan shadow=maya note="sam delayed - flight cancelled"

oncall-bot: Escalation updated. primary=lucas secondary=jordan shadow=maya — note added.

maya: thanks @lucas. i'm going to hold a short handoff channel at 01:55 UTC so i can brief you on what i observed during the first hour (logs, any noisy customers).

sam: super grateful — i'm trying to rebook but please push any follow-ups into this thread. i'll DM if i can make part of the shift remotely. sorry for the scramble. :pray:

lucas: no problem. i'll take ownership. tagging incident channels: #inc-7821, please post any customer escalations there. i'll run a quick health check at 00:05 UTC and post results here.

jordan: noted. i'll keep an eye on error budget and latency dashboards. if latency > 3s for > 2min we escalate to infra-sig.

maya: +1. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
